note: Buckmaster argues that even a machine-verified proof of a major conjecture leaves open why it is true, and calls for protecting researchers’ unpublished work from AI companies through data agreements, opt-in training and open-weight models. He also proposes credit systems that reward understanding and exposition rather than priority.
title: Mathematics is a subject for the young
who: Tristan Buckmaster (NYU), guest post on Terence Tao’s blog
